new_libraries.name: WisBlockLoRaWAN
new_libraries.author: Bernd Giesecke bernd@giesecke.tk
new_libraries.sentence: Unified LoRaWAN (Class A/B/C) and LoRa P2P library for RAKwireless WisBlock boards using Semtech SX1262 + LoRa Basics Modem.
new_libraries.paragraph: Supports RAK4631 (nRF52840), RAK3312 (ESP32-S3) and RAK11310/RAK11300 (RP2040, Arduino-Pico core by Earle Philhower) with built-in SX1262. Provides AT command interface and C++ API. LoRaWAN engine is built on Semtech's LoRa Basics Modem (BasicModem/LBM) stack.

library.name: GroqAudioStream
library.author: Abi
library.sentence: INMP441 capture and quiet streaming speech-to-text for Groq Whisper on ESP32.
library.paragraph: Captures 16 kHz mono audio, applies configurable VAD/filtering/gain, streams to Groq Whisper, and returns a transcript. Library serial logging is disabled by default and can be enabled with Config.debugOutput. Created and maintained by Abi.
